hints.label: nudge
hints.text: The slow request is not big; it is shaped a certain way. Try the same input with one more character and time it.

hints.label: pointer to the signal
hints.text: Time the username and tag validators with a string of 30 letters followed by a character that is not allowed. Look at how the pattern lets the engine split a run of letters between nested groups.

hints.label: near-solution
hints.text: A quantified group whose body can match the same text in several ways causes backtracking explosion. Make each step of the pattern unambiguous (a run, then an optional separator, then a run) and re-run the old-vs-new comparison on short strings.
